description.text: The twelfth and last expansion of the Sun & Moon series, released on 6 September 2019, with Arceus & Dialga & Palkia-GX on the wrapper. Mega Lopunny & Jigglypuff-GX and Naganadel & Guzzlord-GX are its other TAG TEAMs, with Volcarona-GX, Oricorio-GX and Flygon-GX, and the set brought TAG TEAM Supporters, two Trainers on one card, such as Red & Blue and Cynthia & Caitlin. Its Island Challenge Amulet was banned from the Extra format 28 days after release, the fastest ban in the game's history. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 95, ending with four Trainer Rare cards marked TR, followed by full-art Super Rare cards, the TAG TEAMs in two versions each, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Tag Call, Island Challenge Amulet and Giant Hearth. In English many of its cards came out in Cosmic Eclipse in November 2019.
